t: You're looking at the Grace Gates, the W. G. Grace Memorial Gates, two pairs of gates on St John's Wood Road at the entrance to Lord's Cricket Ground. They were put up in 1923, and the gates, with their flanking walls and piers, have been Grade II listed since 1996. They commemorate W. G. Grace, widely held to be one of the greatest cricketers of all time, whose first-class career ran a record-equalling forty-four seasons. The architect was Herbert Baker, who is remembered above all for his work in South Africa.
